title: X Marks the Chug
subtitle: A treasure hunter's guide to Crossbones Isle
version_note: Chapter 7 Treasure Hunters mini-season, v43.00. Facts checked 2 November 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book for the Treasure Hunters mini-season: the map, the loot, the new Sprites, buried treasure and Captain X's mystery, with real-world pirate history along the way.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. A true treasure hunter collects words as well as gold. Try to use three of these before the weekend.

chapters.title: All Aboard!
chapters.toc: What Treasure Hunters is and how this book works
chapters.label: Start here
chapters.dek: A skull-shaped island, rubber pirates, buried treasure and a masked captain with a secret. Here's what's going on, and how to use this book.

chapters.title: Welcome to Crossbones Isle
chapters.toc: Every location, and where to land
chapters.dek: A duck-shaped yacht, a lantern-lit maze, a cursed cave and a rapper's warship. Take the grand tour of the new island.

chapters.title: Cannonball Run
chapters.dek: Fire yourself out of a cannon, slingshot across the bay with rubber arms, or rocket into the sky. How to get around Crossbones Isle, fast.

chapters.title: Sprite Ho!
chapters.toc: Every new Sprite, variants and Mastery
chapters.dek: Thirteen new Sprites, from a banana skeleton to a Mythic grinning skull. Who they are, what they do, and where they hide.

chapters.title: X Marks the Spot
chapters.toc: Wanted Posters, Sprite Chests and Map Fragments
chapters.dek: Wanted Posters, red Xs and a map that's being torn out one piece at a time. Grab a pickaxe: we're going digging.
